title: shawk / Impact
description: What removing a host would break: its dependents in the time range, how often they use it, and whether the host was watched. Only TCP, UDP and Unix stream sockets are observed; RDMA (InfiniBand, RoCE) is not.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.query: SELECT host FROM shawk_v1.agents UNION SELECT host FROM shawk_v1.inventory ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT host FROM shawk_v1.agents UNION SELECT host FROM shawk_v1.inventory ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Verdict

targets.rawSql:
SELECT verdict, array_to_string(reasons, ', ') AS reasons, array_to_string(caveats, ', ') AS caveats,
       direct AS dependents, coverage, unobserved AS not_observed, gaps, partly_observed AS dropped_flows_for
FROM shawk_v1.impact_verdict(${host:sqlstring}, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(),
       min_coverage => ${min_coverage:sqlstring}::numeric)

panels.description: UNSAFE: the host has dependents in the time range, those of depth 1 below. SAFE: it has none, and the history tells so for the coverage asked of the time range. INCONCLUSIVE: none was seen, but the host was not watched enough to tell; reasons say what was missing (not_observed, before_retention for a time range that starts before the retention of the connector, dropped_flows, udp_not_traced, netns_limited, masquerade_not_traced for a container host whose agent does not learn the clients it masquerades; unknown_host or no_agent for a name no agent reported under). caveats are the same shortfalls where they did not decide the verdict. coverage is from 0 to 1, cut, not rounded: 1 is all of the time range. Only TCP, UDP and Unix stream sockets are observed: a host used over RDMA, or that only forwards packets (a router, a hypervisor, a director or a gateway whose translations are neither learned nor configured), is not seen to be used. For a service or a port of the host alone, use shawk-impact or shawk_v1.impact_verdict().

panels.title: Dependents

targets.rawSql:
SELECT depth, client_host, client_service,
       CASE WHEN masklen(client_addr) = 0 THEN text(client_addr) ELSE host(client_addr) END AS client_addr,
       server_host, server_service, port, proto, observed_by, cadence, period, runs, last_seen, next_expected
FROM shawk_v1.impact(${host:sqlstring}, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), max_depth => ${depth:sqlstring}::integer)
LIMIT 1000

panels.description: The clients of the host (depth 1), and the clients of its dependents after, each at the depth it is first reached. A client without an agent has client_addr, and the host the inventory gives the address. server_service ~relay is a client whose connections the host relays in the kernel, on the virtual port; ~unknown a socket without a known owner. port 0 stands for the ports of a service under the rules of ports. cadence, of the dependents of depth 1, is read from the hours in which the dependency was active: continuous is in use; daily, weekly, monthly and periodic break at their next run, which next_expected estimates; one-off and dormant stopped in the time range; unknown has too little history, or hours that were not recorded. At most 1000 rows.

panels.title: Observation of the host

targets.rawSql:
SELECT host, agent, observed, unobserved AS not_observed, gaps, before_retention,
       partly_observed AS dropped_flows_for, dropped_flows, udp_untraced AS without_udp,
       unix_untraced AS without_unix_sockets, netns_limited AS one_netns_only
FROM shawk_v1.coverage($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), ARRAY[${host:sqlstring}])

panels.description: How much of the time range the history tells what the host was used for, from 0 to 1, and what its agent did not trace. before_retention is the part of the time range before the retention of the connector, whose dependencies are deleted. agent is false for a name no agent ever reported under: such a host is never SAFE.

panels.title: Gaps of the host

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gap_start, gap_end, gap_end - gap_start AS duration, cause
FROM shawk_v1.coverage_gaps($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), ARRAY[${host:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY gap_start DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.description: The gaps that the verdict counts: the time before the retention of the connector (cause retention), and the periods in which no agent observed the host (cause agent), with 3 minutes of tolerance for the delay of writes; a restart of the agent within them is no gap. shawk / Fleet tells which gaps were planned stops: a planned stop is a gap all the same.
